integrity: The lower bound is forced by a perfect matching, the two candidate minima are verified by explicit edge-distance vectors, and equality in the matching bound classifies all minimum vertex covers. A standalone checker independently tests both defining conditions.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to square-page book graphs with at least two pages.
The boundary B_1 = C_4 has four minimum bases and is excluded from the two-basis classification.
Triangular books, longer-cycle books, and arbitrary generalized theta graphs are not covered.
Finite exhaustive verification over 2 <= r <= 9 is corroborative only.
A differently named or non-indexed exact treatment may exist.
title: Dominant edge metric bases of square-page book graphs
